headings.usage: Use for all major section titles, territory names, and epic quest headings. Apply 'tracking-tight' for big sizes.

body.usage: Main UI text, lesson content, and conversational AI text.

data.usage: Horizon Points, Compass Marks, leaderboards, and join codes.

textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on main backgrounds to feel like textured map paper/canvas.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-white/10. Use for AI Copilot panels and floating navigation over the map.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using border-white/10. Use 'tracing beam' gradient borders for active quests or focused AI panels.

grids.explorer_dashboard: Mode A: The Bento Grid (Tetris Mode). Asymmetrical, wide gaps (gap-8), high visual tension. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 for the main quest map and smaller stats cards beside it.
grids.guide_console: Mode B: High Density Grid. gap-4 or gap-6. Clear tables, crisp 1px borders, data-focused layout utilizing the full screen width.

layouts.journey_map: Full-screen relative container. Quests act as absolutely positioned nodes connected by SVG dashed lines. The background should be a rich dark ocean texture.
layouts.general: Mobile-first, generous spacing (p-6 to p-12). Optical alignment over geometric.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with 1px border. Primary buttons use brand gold with dark text. Apply -translate-y-1 and glow shadow on hover.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-slate-900/50), 1px subtle border (border-white/10). No thick shadows, prefer inner glow or crisp edges. Add a top highlight border (border-t-gold/50) to important cards.
components.navigation: Crystal Glass sticky header. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#060B19]/70 border-b border-white/10. Do not use fully transparent headers.
components.ai_chatbot_forge: Floating side panel (Drawer or Sheet from Shadcn). Styled with teal accents (#06B6D4) to differentiate 'AI magic' from 'Quest' elements.
components.tables: Shadcn Table for Guide Console. Minimalist borders, hover effect on rows (bg-white/5).

motion.hover_states: All interactable elements must have explicit hover text and background changes. transition-colors duration-200.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items (Leaderboards, Guide review queue).
motion.map_nodes: Active quest nodes should have a continuous slow 'pulse' animation (scale 1.05 and shadow glow).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a gradient overlay (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-[#060B19] to-transparent) for legibility. Minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactable elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: lucide-react for UI icons (compass, map, ship, anchor, sword, shield).
media.charts: recharts for Guide Console mastery tracking charts (styled with dark theme and gold/teal lines).

3d_libraries_and_steps.framer-motion: Use for 2.5D map node entry animations, SVG path drawing between territories, and micro-interactions.
3d_libraries_and_steps.react-three-fiber: Not strictly required, but if used for a 3D compass on the map, use <Float> and <Environment> to make it feel cinematic. Stick to Framer Motion if building 2D maps for better timeline performance.

hero_background.description: Lit vintage map with candle, perfect for landing page hero section. Add heavy dark overlay.

map_texture.description: Deep blue aerial ocean water texture. Use as the background for the Explorer Journey Map with low opacity.

prop_compass.description: Vintage compass image. Can be used as a decorative element or logo substitute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React components using .jsx or .js extension. No .tsx.
Implement Google Auth on the landing page immediately with roles selection (Explorer vs Guide).

For the Explorer Journey Map, create a relative container with an ocean background image. Position 4 'Territory' nodes absolutely across it using percentages. Connect them with an absolute SVG containing <path> lines.
For the Guide Console, use Shadcn Tabs to separate 'Expeditions', 'Review Queue', and 'Leaderboard Controls'.
Integrate Shadcn UI extensively for standard components, but override styles to match the Luxury Dark & Cartography archetype.
Do not use simple 'Card' wrappers for everything. Let the UI breathe. Use large headings with Cormorant Garamond.
Ensure all testing sequences from the problem statement are functionally connected.
AI Chatbot Forge / Copilot hint panel should be built as an aside or floating panel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties.
Avoid centered generic layouts for text-heavy sections. Use left-aligned layouts to follow reading flow.
Never use placeholder image services. Use the exact Unsplash URLs provided.
Integrate 'sonner' for toast notifications on actions like 'Quest Completed' or 'Points Awarded'.
Enforce high spacing (p-6, p-8) and avoid cramped UI.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements to support tests.
Ensure header nav never has fully transparent background; always use glassmorphism.
